name: Finding Tan'jani
summary: A traveler asks you to find their brother Tan'jani. Messages place him south of Loch Modan, with the latest pointing toward Rog'mar in Riverglades.

sections.title: A Brother Missing
sections.body: A traveler's brother, Tan'jani, has gone searching for something unknown. One message places him somewhere south of Loch Modan. A bloodstained letter mentions Riverglades and Rog'mar farther south, and the traveler asks you to find him there.

faq.answer: Tan'jani is the brother of the traveler asking you to find him.
A bloodstained letter mentions Riverglades and Rog'mar, farther south than Loch Modan.
Tan'jani was always searching for something, but his brother does not know what.
One traveler reported meeting Tan'jani somewhere south of Loch Modan. A bloodstained letter mentions Riverglades and Rog'mar, but most of it cannot be read.
